name: Barbecued Buzzard Wings
summary: Rigglefuzz has every ingredient for his barbecued buzzard wings except the wings themselves.

sections.title: A Local Favorite
sections.body: Rigglefuzz takes pride in his barbecued buzzard wings. He coats the tangy meat in rich sauce, and its aroma carries to hungry folk nearby. He has all the ingredients for a batch but the wings. Bring him four buzzard wings, and he may share the recipe.

faq.q: Who asks for the buzzard wings?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz wants buzzard wings for a batch of his barbecued wings.

faq.q: What does Rigglefuzz offer in return for the wings?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz may share the recipe in return for enough wings.

faq.q: Why does Rigglefuzz need buzzard wings?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz has every ingredient for the dish except the wings.

faq.q: How many wings does Rigglefuzz want?

angles.text: Cooks can learn the recipe for the dish from Rigglefuzz.
